description: Opt-in Claude Code PreToolUse guard. Blocks writes to .env / private-key files, writes that add a hardcoded credential, and git commits whose staged diff adds one. Install: copy hooks/sensitive_data_guard.py to .claude/hooks/ and merge the 'hooks' object below into .claude/settings.json (team) or .claude/settings.local.json (just you). On Windows without python3 on PATH, change 'python3' to 'python'.
